title: Local monitor alert handoff journal
description: One committed, immutable entry <state>/alert-handoff/<sequence>.json of a local monitor's alert journal (plan section 6.4). The file name is the decimal sequence without leading zeros. Compact JSON with sorted keys, at most 4096 bytes. A journal holds at most 256 entries and 1 MiB; the dispatcher delivers the lowest sequence first and removes an entry only after it has acknowledged it.

check.description: The producing monitor; equal to the journal's check.

observed_at.description: UTC observation time, RFC 3339 with whole seconds and a Z suffix.

sequence.description: Monotonic per-check sequence; equal to the file name. Gaps are valid, reuse is not.

state.description: The alert state: a warning status is a failure.
